camel_example: aliyun oceanbasepro DescribeMetricsData --region cn-hangzhou --Metrics sql_all_count --EndTime '2021-06-13T15:40:43Z' --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --GroupByLabels 'app,clusterId' --StartTime '2021-06-13T15:40:43Z' --Labels 'app:OB,clusterId:ob000'
description_en: This API retrieves single- or multi-dimensional monitoring metrics for an OceanBase cluster
description_zh: 该接口用于查询  OceanBase 集群的单维度或者多维度监控指标数据
kebab_example: aliyun oceanbasepro describe-metrics-data --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --start-time 2021-06-13T15:40:43Z --end-time 2021-06-13T15:40:43Z --metrics sql_all_count --labels app:OB,clusterId:ob000 --group-by-labels app,clusterId --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMetricsData

parameters.help_en: The ID of the OceanBase cluster
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The start time for the query. The time must be in UTC and use the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format
parameters.help_zh: 查询监控指标数据的起始时间。 该时间只支持 UTC 时间，格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for the query. The time must be in UTC and use the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format
parameters.help_zh: 查询监控指标数据的结束时间。 该时间只支持 UTC 时间，格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The monitoring metrics to query.
Separate multiple metrics with a comma. For example, "sql_all_count,sql_all_rt...".
parameters.help_zh:
监控指标。
多个指标之间用逗号分隔。例如："sql_all_count,sql_all_rt..."
parameters.name: metrics

parameters.help_en:
A string of key-value pairs. Use a colon (:) to separate keys from values, and a comma (,) to separate key-value pairs. For example: "app:OB,clusterId:ob\\\,tenantId:t\\\,serverId:\\\,zoneId:cn-hangzhou-j".
The supported keys are as follows:
app: The application type. Currently, only OceanBase is supported. clusterId: The ID of the OceanBase cluster. tenantId: The ID of the OceanBase tenant. zoneId: The ID of the OceanBase zone. serverId: The ID of the OBServer node
parameters.help_zh:
一组 kv 组成的字符串，key、value 之间用逗号分隔，kv 对之间用逗号分隔。例如："app:OB,clusterId:ob*****,tenantId:t******,serverId:*****,zoneId:cn-hangzhou-j"。
k 为固定字段： app：表示应用类型，目前仅支持 OceanBase。 clusterId：表示 OceanBase 集群 ID。 tenantId：表示 OceanBase 租户 ID。 zoneId：表示 ob zone id serverId：表示 OBServer 节点 ID
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en: The fields by which to group the results. Separate multiple fields with a comma. For example: "app,clusterId,tenantId"
parameters.help_zh: 用于分组的字段。多个字段之间用逗号分隔。例如："app,clusterId,tenantId"
parameters.name: group_by_labels

parameters.help_en: The metric key by which to sort the results
parameters.name: sort_metric_key

parameters.help_en:
The sort order.

ASC: ascending order.

DESC: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序规则。
升序：ASC。
降序：DESC
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of items to return
parameters.help_zh: 排序后返回的 Data 数组长度
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The replica type.
In OceanBase cluster monitoring, this parameter filters nodes by replica type.
Default (unspecified): Retrieves monitoring data for all replica types. This applies to both OceanBase and access proxy monitoring. FULL: Retrieves monitoring data from full-featured replica nodes only. This value is valid only for OceanBase monitoring. READONLY: Retrieves monitoring data from read-only replica nodes only. This value is valid only for OceanBase monitoring
parameters.help_zh:
副本类型。
OceanBase 集群监控根据副本类型设置节点过滤条件。 默认不传, 可用于 OceanBase 监控或查询访问代理监控，查询 OceanBase 监控时，表示查询所有副本类型节点的监控数据。 FULL，仅对 OceanBase 监控生效，表示只查询全功能副本节点上的监控数据。 READONLY，仅对 OceanBase 监控生效，表示只查询只读副本节点上的监控数据
parameters.name: replica_type

items.description_en: A JSON-formatted string that contains the data points
